mapper.select: SELECT so.id AS order_id, so.order_no AS order_no, so.customer_id AS customer_id, so.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name_snapshot, so.seller_id AS seller_id, so.settlement_customer_id, so.settlement_customer_name_snapshot, so.status FROM sales_order so WHERE so.id = #{orderId} AND so.deleted = FALSE

SELECT so.id AS order_id, so.order_no AS order_no, so.customer_id AS customer_id, so.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name_snapshot, so.seller_id AS seller_id, so.settlement_customer_id, so.settlement_customer_name_snapshot, so.status FROM sales_order so WHERE so.id = #{orderId} AND so.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.refund_no AS refund_no, r.order_id AS order_id, r.customer_id AS customer_id, r.refund_amount AS refund_amount, r.status AS status FROM order_refund r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.id FROM finance_payment p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = #{orderRefundId} AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM order_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_refund r WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND r.deleted = FALSE AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_refund p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.deleted = FALSE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_payment p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE)))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_balance_movement m JOIN order_refund r ON m.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND m.source_id = r.id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND m.deleted = FALSE)
